orchestrator.description: Pipeline lead. Receives feature requests, delegates to subagents per the protocol in orchestrator.md, integrates outputs, and delivers.

design-overseer.description: Visual and UX direction. Produces specs, CSS token choices, animation plans. Multimodal — can analyze mockups, screenshots, and visual references.

build-craftsman.description: Implements Astro components, React islands, GSAP animations, Cloudflare config. Needs strong code generation.

qa-guardian.description: Quality gate. Runs pnpm check, pnpm build, validates against AGENTS.md rules. Multimodal — can compare screenshots for visual regression. Read-only.
